nodes.label: graphify query command
nodes.rationale: First action for any question about the repo's architecture, structure, components, or how to add/modify/find code when graphify-out/graph.json exists; returns a scoped subgraph that is much smaller than the full report or raw grep output.

nodes.label: OmniRoute Gateway (default OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
nodes.rationale: OmniRoute is a local OpenAI-compatible gateway (default base URL http://localhost:20128/v1, default model gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview) chosen as the default AI endpoint because it is free/local and works with the app's OpenAI-compatible client; any other OpenAI-compatible provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama) can be substituted.

nodes.label: Turn-based Voice Architecture
nodes.rationale: Design decision: the app was migrated from the Gemini Live API (WebSocket) to a turn-based voice architecture (STT -> chat completions -> TTS) because it is simpler and works with any OpenAI-compatible gateway. The chat model is the 'brain' and is mandatory to configure (base URL + model); STT/TTS default to browser engines that need no API key and can optionally switch to the OmniRoute gateway when credentials are available.

nodes.label: Longer Coach Replies Behavior
nodes.rationale: Feature: after each user turn, the AI Coach does not stop at correction/suggestion but extends the dialogue with 2-3 sentences derived from the user's last utterance, structured as react -> expand -> follow-up question. Implemented purely in the system prompt (SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION in constants.ts) so the app logic (parsing [Correction]/[Assessment]/[Insight] blocks, TTS on non-block text) is unchanged. The /translate mode is scoped to keep replies short. Verified by lint pass (tsc --noEmit) and manual OmniRoute /v1/chat/completions calls in daily and translate modes. Risk: model may break block format (insert [Correction] mid-speech or write the student turn itself); mitigation is the 'react and extend, then STOP' instruction plus the legacy 'STOP and WAIT' rule.
